theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (G : Euclid n → Euclid P) (A : Set (Euclid n)) (L : NNReal) (m : ℝ), LipschitzWith L G → MeasurableSet A → 0 < m → (∀ a ∈ A, ∀ a' ∈ A, m * ‖a - a'‖ ≤ ‖G a - G a'‖) → ∀ f : Euclid P → ℝ≥0∞, Measurable f → ∫⁻ u in A, f (G u) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal ((m ^ n)⁻¹) * ∫⁻ x in G '' A, f x ∂μHE[n]
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
